$comment: Register the loopsmith control plane as a local MCP server. Copy the `mcpServers` block into .mcp.json at your project root, or run: claude mcp add loopsmith -- loopsmith mcp --state ./state

$tools.$comment: What the server exposes. Note the omission: there is no tool that sets a goal satisfied. The gate owns that ruling and is not reachable as a mutation, which is what keeps a hands-off run honest.
$tools.loopsmith_plan: Waves, critical path, parallel fraction, chosen concurrency, predicted speedup.
$tools.loopsmith_gate_evaluate: Run the deterministic gate and return per-check verdicts. Reports a ruling; cannot set one.
$tools.loopsmith_ledger: Append-only audit trail for a run, including every stop-gate trigger.
$tools.loopsmith_goal_states: Current gate rulings for every goal plus `overall`.
$tools.loopsmith_record_episode: Record what a node produced. Refused without provider provenance.
$tools.loopsmith_scratchpad: Read or write the per-goal notes carried between iterations.

$alternative_transports.$comment: If the binary is not on PATH, point at it directly.
